sections.text_helper: Section 32.5.22 "TIM alternate function register 2 (TIM_AF2)" in chapter 32 (General-purpose timers(TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1253.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:16 OCRSEL[3:0]: ocref_clr source selection
These bits select the ocref_clr input source.
0000: tim_ocref_clr0
0001: tim_ocref_clr1
...
0111: tim_ocref_clr15
Refer to Section32.4.2: TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5 pins and internal signals for product specific
implementation.
Bits 15:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
